note: The time series 2010–2014 has been recalculated at the publication of reference month September 2017.
Revised figures 2018-02-06. In connection with the December 2017 publication, statistics on the motor vehicle industry, linked aggregates and total industry were revised from January 2016.

Correction 2018-02-06. In connection with publication of the reference month December 2017, the model-estimated historical information on total industry has been revised for the months of January between 2010 and 2014 in fixed prices, which impacts seasonal adjustment throughout the series. This is due to a calculation error discovered in the backcasting model.

In connection with the November 2018 publication, statistics on the motor vehicle industry, linked aggregates and total industry were revised from January 2017 onwards as a result of new information to Statistics Sweden.

In connection with the December 2018 publication, statistics on telecommunication companies (61), linked aggregates and total private sector were revised for December 2017 as a result of new information received by Statistics Sweden.

In connection with the March 2019 publication, statistics on the industry for chemical, chemical products and pharmaceutical products (20-21) were revised for January and March 2018 as a result of new information to Statistics Sweden. The statistics on support activities for transportation (52), computer programming (62) and research and development (72) were corrected from January 2017 onwards. The corrections also apply to all aggregates that include the above activities.

Methodological changes  
- 2024-11-21: When publishing the reference quarter 3 2024, changes are implemented that aim to increase the quality of the statistics. The changes involve revisions, in most cases small, from April 2018 to August 2024 in several industries and aggregates. Part of this improvement is due to the enhancement of methods for constant price calculations from January 2022 and onwards, which affect the industries of Education (P), Human health and social work activities (Q), Arts, entertainment and recreation (R) and Other service activities (S) and all aggregates that include these activities.  
- 2024-08-20: New decision-making rules have been introduced for the classification of head offices with extensive operations abroad or other Swedish corporate entities. The implementation will take place gradually, starting from the reference year 2022. As a result of the new decision-making rules, some large head offices have been reclassified as independent units and instead of support activities are regarded as primary activities. These kind-of-activity units are now included in the population with industry 70.1 head office activities. The change affects all aggregates in the statistics, which include industry 70.1.  
- 2025-05-21: In connection with the publication of reference months January-March 2025, a change in methodology will be introduced regarding the handling of VAT data when used as a source of turnover. The change will entail revisions from April 2019 onwards, in most cases very small and not sufficient to affect published statistical values.

In connection with the publication of reference month August 2019, the periods from January 2018 to March 2019 (outside the regular revision period) have been revised due to new data submitted to Statistics Sweden.
In connection with the publication of reference month October 2019, statistics on the petroleum industry, linked aggregates and total private sector were revised from January 2018 onwards.
